It can also appear in the Daily Skin Store for {{Coins|55,000}}. You automatically unlock the '''Golden Scout's''' normal counterpart, the [[Scout]], when you first join in the game. The '''Golden Scout''' is very cheap in comparison to other towers, meaning that it can be placed right from the start of the game. However, the '''Golden Scout''' has mediocre DPS, meaning that in harder modes it is not that effective later on during the game. In comparison to its normal counterpart, the [[Scout]], it is considerably more expensive to upgrade. Despite this, the '''Golden Scout''' is significantly better than its normal counterpart because it has much higher DPS and efficiency. The '''Golden Scout''' is considered an early-game to mid-game tower, although it can handle the late-game with some support. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Higher Caliber|Cost = {{Money|150}}|Image = [[File:Stronger Bullets.png|100px]]|Information = 0.75 > 0.5 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +1 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|133}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 2|Upgrade Title = Precise Aiming|Cost = {{Money|600}}|Image = [[File:GScoutLevel2Upgrade.png|100px]]|Information = +3 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +Hidden Detection {{Hidden|Hidden Detection}} Sell Price changes to {{Money|333}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 3|Upgrade Title = Golden Deagle|Cost = {{Money|1,800}}|Image = [[File:Scout4.png|100px]]|Information = +25 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] 0.5 > 1.2 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +3 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] +Lead Detection {{Lead|Lead Detection}} Sell Price changes to {{Money|933}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 4|Upgrade Title = Twin Sovereigns|Cost = {{Money|4,000}}|Image = [[File:Scout5.png|100px]]|Information = 1.2 > 0.6 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +6 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|2,266}}}} ==Statistics== ''To see all the previous statistics of this tower, see the [[/History|history]] page.'' {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $CE$ = Total Cost / DPS $TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$ $COST$ = 250; 150; 600; 1800; 4000 $FSE-UPGRADE$ = Higher Caliber; Precise Aiming; Golden Deagle; Twin Sovereigns $FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = 3032133716; 115730014; 3278741672; 3279537687 $FSE-DETECTION$ = 2; 3; $FSE-META$ = Golden Perks; File:GoldenScout3.png $R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$

This means that the '''Golden Scout''' can be used to defend against weaker [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, like the [[Hidden]] and [[Shadow]], while you can work on getting more expensive towers and upgrades. **It can also defend well against [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies with higher health such as the [[Hidden Boss]] or [[Shadow Boss]] at later levels, when multiple of them are placed down. **It also has cheap lead penetration, making it useful for enemies like [[Lead]] and [[Elite Lead]]. However, it does not have flying detection, so it cannot target the [[Lead Balloon]] while its balloons are not popped. *The '''Golden Scout''' can be used as a cheap way to distract enemies like the [[Molten Boss]] from using their abilities on more useful towers, like the [[Accelerator]]. **This could be risky however, due to the tower slot limit of 5, you may not be able to choose better towers. ***You can use the '''Golden Scout''' to deal with the early waves to give it some use other than distracting bosses' abilities. *The [[DJ Booth]] can increase the '''Golden Scout's''' somewhat short range. ==Trivia== *The '''Golden Scout's''' name and function are loosely based on the ''Tower Battles''' [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Golden_Scout|Golden Scout]]. *The '''Golden Scout''' is the only public golden tower that has different upgrade icons than its normal counterpart. **If exclusive towers are included, then the [[Golden Snowballer]] also has different icons. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page. {{scroll|text = *'''13 May 2022''' -
